summary: Replaced the process-wide settings with a frozen Settings value and make(), threaded `conf` through all code that needs settings, and removed import-time and stale caches (units, dims, timeutil, tax default, carrier minimum/fuel factor, fx factors, memo keys now include the settings). Tests were moved to the new API and pass; I had no copy of the original package, so the CLI output could only be checked by running it, not diffed against the old version.
